title: LLM-Enhanced Deep Reinforcement Learning with Human-in-the-Loop Calibration for Real-Time Optimal Power Flow
abstract: arXiv:2611.15003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-time optimal power flow (RT-OPF) requires fast and reliable decision-making under time-varying operating conditions. However, many practical operating preferences and safety related requirements are difficult to encode using conventional numerical rewards alone, which limits the effectiveness and controllability of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for RT-OPF. To address this issue, this paper proposes an LLM-enhanced DRL framework with human-in-the-loop (HITL) for RT-OPF. The proposed method augments the physics-based reward with sparse language evaluative feedback during offline training, so that semantic operational requirements can be incorporated into policy learning. To improve reliability in RT-OPF, a selective HITL calibration mechanism is further introduced to inspect and correct questionable LLM judgments before they continuously shape the learning process. translated_title: 面向实时最优潮流的基于人在回路校准的大语言模型增强深度强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 实时最优潮流（RT-OPF）要求在时变运行条件下做出快速且可靠的决策。然而，许多实际的运行偏好和安全相关要求难以仅通过常规数值奖励来编码，这限制了深度强化学习（DRL）在实时最优潮流中的有效性和可控性。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种面向实时最优潮流的带人在回路（HITL）的大语言模型（LLM）增强深度强化学习框架。所提方法在离线训练阶段通过稀疏的语言评价反馈来增强基于物理的奖励，从而将语义化的运行要求纳入策略学习过程。为提高实时最优潮流的可靠性，本文进一步引入了一种选择性的人在回路校准机制，在有疑问的LLM判断持续影响学习过程之前对其进行检查和纠正。在IEEE 30节点和IEEE 118节点系统上的案例研究表明……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种带选择性人在回路校准机制的LLM增强深度强化学习框架，通过稀疏语言评价反馈将语义化运行与安全要求融入实时最优潮流的策略学习，并在可疑LLM判断影响训练前加以检查纠正，从而提升决策的有效性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-enhanced deep reinforcement learning framework with a selective human-in-the-loop calibration mechanism for real-time optimal power flow, which incorporates semantic operational and safety requirements into policy learning via sparse language evaluative feedback and inspects and corrects questionable LLM judgments before they shape the training process.
